messages:
lee: morning restore for tenant-beta failed with 'decrypt AccessDenied' at 01:22. Backup job shows authenticated calls but there are no KMS Decrypt audit entries for the CMK. Anyone seen a proxy swallow before?
kms-proxy: alert: PROXY_DENY key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/ck-b02 reason=no-grant-found
tori: we pushed an RBAC tidy last night that renamed serviceaccounts under `svc-storage:` namespace. If our grant mapping only keys off the old email we could miss.
sam: pulled proxy logs: `2026-09-12T01:22:11Z WARN req=fd21 principal=svc-storage/uploader mapping_key=svc-uploader-old -> 403 no-grant-found` so proxy rejected before calling KMS. explains missing Decrypt.
remy: unrelated but flagged during triage: uploader v1 writes `/tmp/back-upload-plain-*` during multipart assembly. We patched in staging but need a coorded rollout; GH#11021.
lee: immediate mitigations: 1) create a short-lived grant for the new SA alias so restores can continue, 2) run a decrypt smoke test through proxy, 3) add proxy audit forwarder to SIEM for denied principals.
incident-bot: emergency grant created (10m) by tori.
tori: after grant, smoke test `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <tok>" https://kms-proxy.internal/v1/decrypt -d '{"key":"ck-b02","ciphertext":"..."}'` returned 200 and a KMS Decrypt audit entry appeared. restore resumed, 3/4 shards succeeded immediately; last shard timed out then recovered after retry.
remy: short-term uploader mitigation: set TMPDIR to `/var/opt/backups/tmp` with 0700 perms and unlink after upload. Long-term: move to streaming encrypt path to avoid FS cleartext.
sam: follow-ups: 1) update RBAC rename playbook to include grant-mapping reconciliation and UID fallback, 2) add integration test that simulates SA rename and asserts KMS Decrypt audit presence, 3) implement proxy metric `kms.proxy.denied` and forward denied principal+key to SIEM.
lee: create alert rule: if a backup-service principal shows auth traffic but zero KMS Decrypt events in 10m, page oncall. Assign owners and schedule a brief postmortem. :thumbsup:
